% Error bar style and error mark options (rotate, colour, size), a filled
% error mark, y fixed. Behaviour X2.
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[xmin=0, xmax=4, ymin=0, ymax=5]
  \addplot+[error bars/.cd, y dir=both, y fixed=0.5, error bar style={red, thick}, error mark options={rotate=90, blue, mark size=3pt}] coordinates {(1,2) (2,3)};
  \addplot+[mark=none, error bars/.cd, y dir=plus, y fixed=0.75, error mark=*] coordinates {(3,1) (3.5,2)};
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
